title: Speedrunning Relational Foundation Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.28855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Progress on foundation model pretraining is gated by who can afford a trial, and relational pretraining is no exception. Recipes are developed inside individual labs, reported under private protocols, and do not accumulate. Speedrun leaderboards remove that barrier by decentralizing the search rather than the training run. The problem is fixed, the stack is open, entries are ranked by wall-clock time to a quality target, and one GPU is enough to hold the record. We introduce modded-nanoRT, the first such leaderboard for Relational Transformers. Which database to hold out decides whether the benchmark can resolve improvements at all, so we fix it by calibration, ranking six candidates by how sharply a 45-minute learning curve separates improvement from seed noise. We open the leaderboard with typed trilinear attention, a relational operator that conditions attention scores and values on the foreign key traversed, together with Muon and SI

translated_title: 关系型基础模型预训练的速通竞赛
translated_abstract: 基础模型预训练的进展受限于谁有能力承担试验成本，关系型预训练也不例外。预训练配方在各个实验室内部开发，以私有协议汇报，无法相互积累。速通排行榜通过将搜索过程（而非训练运行本身）去中心化来消除这一障碍。问题固定、技术栈开源、参赛者以到达质量目标的实际耗时排名，且一块GPU就足以刷新纪录。我们推出了modded-nanoRT，这是首个针对关系型Transformer的此类排行榜。选择留出哪个数据库决定了基准测试能否有效分辨改进，因此我们通过校准来固定这一选择，即根据45分钟学习曲线区分改进与随机种子噪声的敏锐程度，对六个候选数据库进行排名。我们以类型化三线性注意力开启该排行榜，这是一种关系算子，使注意力分数和数值以所遍历的外键为条件，同时结合了Muon和SI（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文推出了首个关系型Transformer速通排行榜modded-nanoRT，通过固定问题、开源技术栈、以单GPU到达质量目标的实际耗时排名来实现关系型基础模型预训练研究的去中心化，并以类型化三线性注意力关系算子开启首个纪录。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces modded-nanoRT, the first speedrun leaderboard for Relational Transformers, which decentralizes relational foundation model pretraining research by fixing the problem, open-sourcing the stack, and ranking single-GPU entries by wall-clock time to a quality target, opening the record with typed trilinear attention, a relational operator conditioning attention scores and values on the foreign key traversed.
